dataDbRecovery.title: Repair vault database
dataDbRecovery.message: Memry's database for this vault is damaged.
dataDbRecovery.detail: Your notes and journal files are not affected. Repair keeps the damaged database as a backup at {path}, starts a fresh one, rebuilds what it can from your vault files, and restores synced items on the next sync. Changes that had not synced yet are recovered where possible.

obsidianVault.title: Open Obsidian vault
obsidianVault.message: Open a copy of this Obsidian vault?
obsidianVault.detail:
Opening an Obsidian vault in memrynote can lose data your Obsidian plugins rely on. When memrynote turns a plugin's task line into a task, it rewrites the line. Fields such as the Tasks plugin's due dates leave the file, and Obsidian no longer sees them.

memrynote can copy “{name}” to “{copyName}” next to it and open the copy. “{name}” stays exactly as it is.
obsidianVault.detailExistingCopy:
Opening an Obsidian vault in memrynote can lose data your Obsidian plugins rely on. When memrynote turns a plugin's task line into a task, it rewrites the line. Fields such as the Tasks plugin's due dates leave the file, and Obsidian no longer sees them.

A memrynote copy, “{copyName}”, is already next to it. memrynote can open that copy. “{name}” stays exactly as it is.

webview2Missing.title: MemryNote can't start
webview2Missing.body:
MemryNote needs the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime to show its window, and installing it didn't work. Download the installer from Microsoft ({url}), run it, then reopen MemryNote.

Open the download page now?

failed.title: MemryNote couldn't finish starting
failed.body: This can happen when the disk is very low on free space, or with older graphics drivers. Try freeing up some disk space, then reopen MemryNote. If it keeps happening, reinstalling usually clears it.

crashed.title: MemryNote stopped working
crashed.body: The page kept stopping, so MemryNote stopped reloading it. Close this window to quit, then reopen MemryNote. If it keeps happening, reinstalling usually clears it.
crashed.details: The page process ended {count} times in a minute ({reason}).

startup.reloaded: MemryNote reloaded after a crash. Recent edits may be lost.
